_doc: THE LOOM symbol & convention registry (Loom v3, method #5). One definition per symbol; scripts and notes must use these names. Add before use; never redefine.

eps.def: tau - tau0 (displacement of the modulus from the knot)

beta_c.def: d ln m / d phi with canonical phi (L = 1/2 (dphi)^2)

alpha_DEF.def: Damour-Esposito-Farese coupling = sqrt(2) beta_c; gamma-1 = -2 alpha^2/(1+alpha^2)

b_prime.def: heterotic duality-anomaly coefficient -C(G) + sum T(R)(1+2n); NOT the brane N=2 sector beta

b_N2_brane.def: beta coefficient of massless N=2 multiplets from annuli of branes parallel on the torus (incl. Z2-twisted aa on Z6')

U_rho_torus.def: complex structure of a Z3-twisted torus: FROZEN at rho (cannot be displaced by F-terms)

U_i_torus.def: complex structure of the Z2-only torus: FREE modulus; U = i is a choice

g_s.note: S at rho => 2/sqrt3; S at i => 1 (D1919)

h21_Z6II.def: number of complex-structure moduli of the Z6-II fold
h21_Z6II.value: 1 untwisted (U3, the Z2 torus) on SU(2)xSU(6); others twisted

flavour_tau.def: the modulus whose distance from a knot sets the residual-charge hierarchy
flavour_tau.status: NO modular-tau home near rho in Z6-II (D1922/D1923). Candidates: U3 (near i), discrete data, Froggatt-Nielsen spurions (twisted moduli, bulk-brane positions, recombination flavons). One-spurion viability OPEN (D1925a/D1927: knife-edge NONE at 0.02587; natural one-spurion fits at 0.0259-0.027 per unlocked referee sweep); "two sizes needed" UNPROVEN (D1923a). S excluded.

S_vacuum.status: S at i: inflation PASS (D1926), but alpha_s FAIL with its heavier spectrum (D1929: 0.1112, -7.5 sigma; Delta3 doubles) => disfavoured by forces; S at rho baseline (g_s = 2/sqrt3, CONDITIONAL). g_s = 1 CONDITIONAL (D1919a).

U32_single_flavon.status: PHENOMENOLOGICAL postulate (D1928 PASS): one FN flavon, natural window |u| = 0.063-0.148 (factor 2.34, P = 0.29); assignment varies across window; no geometric home yet.

alpha_s_baseline.status: scoreboard uses 0.1147 (gluino 5565 GeV, D1816); referee-corrected gluino 4.93 TeV gives 0.1142 (-4.2 sigma) per D1929 run 1 - carry into next scoreboard
